key_highlights: ASX slides lower driven by a $1.4T Wall Street wipeout, despite major banks rallying on Westpac's $6.8B profit.
Australian housing downturn intensifies with prices dropping for a seventh consecutive month and Westpac forecasting an 11% decline.
Coles suffers multi-billion dollar market value wipeout amid market share losses to Woolworths.
KMD Brands (Rip Curl owner) engages in takeover discussions with a US retail giant, boosting discretionary M&A interest.

sectors.trend: Westpac posted a resilient $6.8B profit supporting bank shares, even as it projects an 11% housing decline.
sectors.implications: Near-term dividend support intact across major lenders, but credit loss provisions face medium-term upward pressure.

sectors.trend: Coles loses ground to Woolworths wiping out billions, while Rip Curl owner enters US buyout talks.
sectors.implications: Margin contraction in staples; divergence favours WOW.AX over COL.AX, while retail M&A provides targeted catalysts.

sectors.trend: Gold faces capitulation selling pressures, though exploration juniors report positive drill hits across WA.
sectors.implications: Headwinds for gold producers (NST.AX, EVN.AX), while base and battery metal explorers see speculative trading.

sectors.trend: Housing values downgraded further amid seventh monthly fall and weakest auction market since 2020.
sectors.implications: Structural drag on residential developers and REITs exposed to domestic residential volumes.

key_themes: Macroeconomic tightening and high borrowing costs depressing property values and consumer sentiment.
Spillover from global equity rout and cryptocurrency flash crash dampening risk appetite.
Supermarket competition escalating margin pressures within consumer staples.
Divergence between solid bank corporate balance sheets and deteriorating household debt indicators.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight residential property developers and limit exposure to high-LTV lending exposures.
Hold cash buffers and hedge broad index exposure via protective index overlays.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fiscal Debt Expansion and High Borrowing Costs
risk_assessment.mitigation: Focus on low-leverage companies with strong balance sheets and pricing power.

opportunities.recommendation: Pair trade: Long Woolworths / Short Coles
opportunities.rationale: Woolworths is capturing market share as Coles faces operational and competitive margin headwinds.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical accumulation of major banks on yield support
opportunities.rationale: Westpac's $6.8B profit confirms robust near-term capital returns despite macroeconomic headwinds.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to residential-heavy REITs and housing developers
defensive_moves.rationale: Seven straight months of property value declines and poor auction clearances threaten earnings.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge equity exposure against Wall Street downside volatility
defensive_moves.rationale: A $1.4T US equity sell-off poses downside beta risk to the broader ASX 200.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to remain subdued and volatile, pinned down by global risk-off cues and housing headwinds.
market_outlook.long_term: Earnings compression across rate-sensitive consumer and real estate sectors, with performance tied to RBA policy trajectory.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decisions and monetary policy statements
CoreLogic monthly home value index and auction clearance figures
Australian retail trade and CPI inflation prints
US equity market stabilization and geopolitical developments
watch_list: RBA Cash Rate path and bond yields
AUD/USD currency movements and commodity pricing
Major bank net interest margins and bad debt provisions
US inflation and equity volatility metrics
